Dear Customer Support Team,

I am following up on my previous email regarding the shipping status of my order for the Magic M. 40T miners, with Order Number: Shop····, Order Shop····.

As mentioned, the order was scheduled to ship on November 14, 2026, and I have not yet received confirmation or an update regarding the shipment. Could you please provide the status at your earliest convenience?

Given the previous delays and my consideration of alternative options, it would be helpful to know the current expected timeline.

Best regards,

Larry D.

  (email hidden)

  (address hidden)

  (contact hidden)

Hi Larry,

I'm sorry. Both orders passed their November 14 date without shipping, and when you asked on November 17 you didn't get a real answer. You should have.

Here's where things stand. You placed Shop···· on September 24 and Shop···· on September 26, and each one is a Magic M. 40T. All 300 units in this production run are on their way to our warehouses now. Both your miners are part of it. Your two orders can realistically ship by November 30. Each one will get its own tracking number by email as soon as it leaves our warehouse.

You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking emails go to the address on your orders, which is the one you've used with us before, not (contact hidden). Our emails have been going to spam for some customers, so please check that folder. It also helps to add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

If you'd like to talk through anything else on either order, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
